gim4305_comparator.price_note: USD 110 is a published approximate Pupper BOM unit cost; USD 130 is a planning allowance, neither is a verified current quote.

interpretation: DM-J4310 is a credible low-reduction torque-controlled candidate. Higher published torque at a similar advertised USD price warrants comparison; rejecting it merely as an arm motor is unjustified.

Twelve V1.1 units add approximately 1.8 kg versus the catalog GIM4305 reference. V1.2 adds approximately 2.1 kg. These are actuator-only comparison scenarios, not selected joint counts or complete robot masses.

Higher torque also increases available load capacity. Motor mass alone cannot rank loaded acceleration; rotor inertia, limb placement, gearbox friction, torque-speed curve and controller delay are unresolved.
DM-J3507 is a directly relevant smaller competitor. Smaller diameter, output encoder and CAN FD do not by themselves prove better leg response or transfer.

Pupper provides directly relevant public quadruped learning/deployment resources for GIM4305. The Damiao manufacturer's Wheel-legged repository description documents four DM4310 units; it is not evidence of a kitten quadruped learning policy.
Keep catalog rated/peak torque, no-load speed and real loaded response separate; peak duration and enclosed cooling conditions remain unverified.
evidence_limit: Read product pages, manuals and project documentation. Did not run either robot, watch a full DM4310 walking demonstration, measure a motor, or establish that no other legged project exists.
